targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.source_id,
  p.source,
  p.region,
  p.country,
  p.info_url,
  p.fetched_at,
  p.updated_at,
  now() - p.updated_at AS catalog_age,
  (p.properties->>'stall_count')::int AS stall_count,
  (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int AS max_power_kw,
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') ELSE 0 END AS pricebook_count,
  (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS detail_captured,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,site_status}' AS site_status,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,project_status}' AS project_status,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,access_type}' AS access_type,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,open_to_non_tesla}' AS open_to_non_tesla,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' AS charging_accessibility
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring};

SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.source_id,
  p.region,
  p.country,
  (p.properties->>'stall_count')::int AS stall_count,
  (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int AS max_power_kw,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' AS charging_accessibility,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring};

SELECT
  p.properties#>>'{facility}' AS facility,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,timeZone}' AS time_zone,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,address,streetNumber}' AS street_number,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,address,street}' AS street,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,address,city}' AS city,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,address,state}' AS state,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,address,country}' AS country,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,detail,address,postalCode}' AS postal_code,
  p.properties->'upstream'->'detail'->'amenities' AS amenities,
  p.properties->'upstream'->'index'->'supercharger_function' AS index_status
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring};

SELECT
  e.row_num,
  e.pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' AS vehicle_make_type,
  e.pricebook->>'feeType' AS fee_type,
  e.pricebook->>'currencyCode' AS currency,
  e.pricebook->>'uom' AS unit,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateBase', '')::numeric AS rate_base,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateTier1', '')::numeric AS rate_tier_1,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateTier2', '')::numeric AS rate_tier_2,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'minSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS min_site_occupancy,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'maxSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS max_site_occupancy,
  e.pricebook->>'isMemberPricebook' AS member_pricebook,
  e.pricebook AS raw_pricebook
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(pricebook, row_num)
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring}
ORDER BY e.row_num ASC;

panels.description: TSLA TOU charging rates by hour of day. Empty if the site has no time-of-use pricebooks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tou AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateBase','')::numeric AS rate_base,
    split_part(e.pricebook->>'startTime', ':', 1)::int AS start_hour,
    split_part(e.pricebook->>'endTime',   ':', 1)::int AS end_hour
  FROM pois p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS e(pricebook)
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.category = 'supercharger'
    AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring}
    AND (e.pricebook->>'isTou')::bool = true
    AND e.pricebook->>'feeType' = 'CHARGING'
    AND e.pricebook->>'uom' = 'kwh'
    AND e.pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' = 'TSLA'
    AND NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'startTime','') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'endTime','')   IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  hour,
  avg(t.rate_base) AS rate_base
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS hour
LEFT JOIN tou t
  ON CASE
       WHEN t.start_hour <= t.end_hour
         THEN hour >= t.start_hour AND hour < t.end_hour
       ELSE hour >= t.start_hour OR  hour < t.end_hour
     END
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;

SELECT
  p.provider_ref,
  p.address,
  p.properties->'upstream'->'index' AS upstream_index,
  p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' AS upstream_detail,
  p.properties AS raw_properties
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring};

list.label: Supercharger
list.name: supercharger_id
list.query:
SELECT
  id::text || ' - ' || name || COALESCE(' [' || NULLIF(region, '') || ']', '') AS __text,
  id::text AS __value
FROM pois
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  AND category = 'supercharger'
ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 5000;
